features.title: Core Technical Architecture
features.subtitle: Built for high reliability, cross-crop safety, and extension officer governance in rural Maharashtra.
features.iqaDesc: Automatically detects blurry, poorly lit, or out-of-focus leaf photos and prompts instant retake before running inference.
features.safetyGateDesc: Prevents hallucinated chemical advice. High-confidence scans get stepped IPM; ambiguous scans are routed to local officers.
features.ipmDesc: Strict sequence: 1. Cultural Hygiene -> 2. Biological Bio-agents -> 3. Approved Chemical Sprays with mandatory safety intervals.
features.mismatchDesc: Automatically detects if a rice leaf is uploaded under tomato, routing to the correct classifier without error.
features.gisDesc: Real-time spatial outbreak cluster detection empowering district officials to contain plant disease spread proactively.
features.offlineDesc: Farmers can scan crops deep in connectivity-free fields; data queues locally and syncs automatically when network returns.
